plan.hypothesis: Persistent SQLite metadata plus existing ordered memory queries avoids whole-manifest allocation/rewrite and redundant SQL round trips while retaining one shared lazy history mechanism.

plan.changesSinceDevelopment: Only sqlite-lazy query backend selection, metadataBackend diagnostic, fingerprint source coverage, and measuring first resumed execution before any history reads; existing modes/API and fact commits unchanged.

confirmation.purpose: held-out synthetic parameter confirmation, not source-isolated Agent ability evidence

plan.replication: five independent processes per mode/case; same final release executable; rotate order; no concurrent build or functional tests during measurement

gates.correctness: all focused and broad regressions pass; no changed snapshots on pure reads; scope limits explicit
gates.warmStartup: target >=20% median reduction at representative large/history workloads
gates.residentMemory: target >=30% reduction in dormant history-heavy workloads
gates.query: target <=25% regression or <=0.5ms additional per100 rows; retain full traversal cost
gates.firstHistory: report cost paid on demand and all-open counterexample, no hidden work exclusion

plan.defaultPolicy: Keep memory compatibility default. Recommend explicit sqlite-lazy for the validated dormant/history-heavy use case if correctness and resource gates pass; do not infer universal benefit or Agent capability gains.
